name: proto-harness
description: Two-regime coding harness: a very fast local model for easy tasks and a cloud model for hard ones, with deferred local RL from logged episodes.

comments.zeroRuntimeDeps: There are intentionally NO runtime dependencies. Everything runs on Node 22 built-ins (fetch, node:test, node:child_process, TypeScript type-stripping). `npm test` works on a fresh clone with no install step.
comments.devDependencies: Only needed for `npm run typecheck` / editor IntelliSense. Safe to omit.
